1.0.1
https://github.com/mcmilk/7-Zip-zstd/tree/master/C/fast-lzma2

Apart from the changes below and line endings, the files are official fast-lzma2 1.0.1
(https://github.com/conor42/fast-lzma2, tag v1.0.1).

GrindCore (audit/native-fixes, audit/other-codecs.md 4.4.1):
- lzma2_enc.c, radix_engine.h, radix_internal.h and radix_mf.c are upstream master's (967306d3), i.e. 1.0.1 plus
  b44b79b9 ("Fix unsafe access to the match table in struct LZMA2_ECtx_s") and a793db99 ("Don't read beyond end
  in RMF_handleRepeat"). Neither changes the compressed output.
- fl2_decompress.c: FL2_decompressDCtx rejects a 0-byte source (marked [audit fix, audit/other-codecs.md 4.4.1]).
